UI ideas:
- dark and sleek with shades of grey and black to make the highlights pronounced

- Spaced repetition reminders: Versed will take into account when you memorized a verse/surah, and will remind you to review it in intervals that become exponentially spaced in order to ingrain the verses in your mind and prevent you from memorizing once and then forgetting. The intervals would be something like: one day after memorized, 3 days, 1 week, 2 weeks, 1 month (this is an example; we would need to do some research on spaced repetition)

Versed
Synopsis: basically turning the Quran memorization accountability thing that Mohammed, Issa, and I have been doing casually for the past couple months into a fleshed out tool.
- An app for Muslims to achieve greater Quranic goals through establishing a sense of accountability.
- Users can create or join a group with their friends or their class.
- Within a group, you and your friends set agreed upon goals, whether they are daily, weekly, or other, in which you specify how much or what specifically to memorize in that time.
- Different plans:
    * Free, individual plan: for everyday users who just want to group up with a few friends.
   * Paid, classroom plan: tailored for Islamic schools that want a platform to facilitate tracking their students' memorization and grading. 
- Testing mode: by the end of the goal period, group members will need to enter a test mode which is basically them pressing a button that says they've done their memorization for the week (or whatever set period) and are ready to prove they have. Testing mode prompts the user to record themselves while reciting what they memorized. In the paid, classroom plan, test mode is more strict: user's recordings will be stopped if they leave the app and their instructor will receive their video with analytics that point out potential red flags in their recording. (I was thinking of implementing eye tracking here and using that to provide analytics)
- Users are able to press a 'nudge' button once a day next to their group members' names in the group to have Versed send them a push notification that reminds them to make progress.
- There's a mushaf built in to the app that users can visually mark to show what they've memorized (perhaps with a green highlight) and what they need to have memorized for the group goal (yellow). 
- Each user can check check on the others' progress by checking their individual mushaf.

The Quran memorization accountability app.
